stemMarkdown: If 12 men can build a wall in 20 days, how many days will 8 men take to build the same wall, working at the same rate? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The wall needs $12 \times 20 = 240$ man-days of effort regardless of who does it. With 8 men that is $\dfrac{240}{8} = 30.0$ days.
